faq.q: How far is Puerto Banús from Starlite Festival?
faq.a: Puerto Banús is about 6 km from the Nagüeles quarry where Starlite is held. A taxi takes 10–15 minutes and costs roughly €15–20. You can also arrange a private transfer through our team.

faq.q: What time should I book my boat for a Starlite concert?
faq.a: Most Starlite concerts start at 21:00 or 22:00. We recommend a 2-hour cruise departing at 17:00 or 18:00, returning to port by 19:00–20:00. This leaves time to freshen up and travel to the venue.

faq.q: Can I watch the concert from the boat?
faq.a: No. Starlite Festival is held in a landlocked quarry 2 km inland. You cannot see or hear the concert from the sea. The boat experience is a pre-concert cruise only.

faq.q: What is included in the boat rental price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA at 21%. No hidden extras.

faq.q: Which boats are best for a Starlite pre-concert group?
faq.a: For groups of 9–11, the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 (€749/2h) are ideal. For up to 12 guests with more space, the Mangusta 80 (€4,719/4h) includes a free jet ski. All depart from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: Do you offer catering or dinner on board?
faq.a: Standard charters include light snacks and drinks. For a full dinner or custom catering, we can arrange it on request. Contact us via WhatsApp for options and pricing.

faq.q: How do I book a boat for Starlite Festival 2028?
faq.a: You can book directly via WhatsApp. Specify your preferred date, boat type, and number of guests. Tier A and B boats have fixed prices online; other boats are quoted individually.
Cancellations made 48 hours before departure receive a full refund. Within 48 hours, a 50% charge applies. No-shows are non-refundable. Weather-related cancellations are fully refunded.

data.body_html:
Starlite Festival 2028 returns to Marbella from July to August, bringing world-class music to the Nagüeles quarry. For a memorable evening, start with a sunset cruise from Puerto Banús before heading to the concert. Our Marbella boat rental fleet offers 17 vessels, from speedy open boats to luxury flybridges, all departing from the port. Prices start at €749 for two hours on an Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, including skipper, drinks, and snacks. This guide covers everything you need to plan the perfect pre-concert cruise.

Why combine a boat rental with Starlite Festival?

A pre-concert cruise turns a night out into a full evening experience. You leave Puerto Banús at 17:00 or 18:00, cruise the Marbella coastline with a glass of cava, watch the sunset over La Concha, and return to port by 20:00. A short taxi ride takes you to Starlite in time for the headline act. It’s a seamless way to enjoy Marbella’s two biggest summer attractions in one night.

Our fleet for Starlite pre-concert cruises

All our boats depart from Puerto Banús. For a Starlite evening, we recommend these options:

  • Tier A boats – Astondoa 40 (12.5 m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5 m, 11 pax). €749 for 2 hours, €2,299 for 8 hours. Ideal for couples or small groups.
  • Tier B boats – Mangusta 80 (24 m, 12 pax) and Mangusta 80 Grey (24 m, 12 pax). €4,719 minimum 4 hours, includes a jet ski. Perfect for larger parties.
  • Other boats – From the Dubhe (8 m, 5 pax) to the Ferretti 94 (29 m, 12 pax). Pricing on request via WhatsApp.

All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and 21% Spanish VAT.

Sample itinerary: Sunset cruise + Starlite

Here’s how a typical evening works:

  • 17:00 – Board your boat at Puerto Banús.
  • 17:15–19:30 – Cruise past the Golden Mile, Cala del Faro, and Cala Cortés. Anchor for a swim if you wish. Drinks and snacks served.
  • 19:45 – Return to Puerto Banús.
  • 20:00–20:30 – Taxi to Starlite (€15–20, 10 min).
  • 21:00/22:00 – Concert starts.

This schedule works for any boat in our fleet. Adjust timings based on the concert start time.

What to expect on board

Marbella’s summer evenings average 28 °C, dropping to 22 °C after sunset. Bring a light jacket for the return cruise. Our boats have shaded decks, sun pads, and onboard sound systems. The skipper handles navigation and anchoring, so you can relax. Standard drinks include water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava. For something stronger, bring your own or request a premium bar package via WhatsApp.

Getting from Puerto Banús to Starlite

The Nagüeles quarry is 6 km north of Puerto Banús. Taxis queue at the port’s main entrance; the fare is around €15–20. Ride-hailing apps like Uber and Bolt also operate in Marbella. If you’re a group of 8+, we can arrange a private minibus transfer – just ask when booking.

Booking tips for Starlite Festival 2028

  • Book your boat at least 2–4 weeks in advance – Starlite weeks are peak season.
  • Check the concert schedule before choosing a date. Headliners sell out fast.
  • For Tier A boats, the 2-hour option (€749) is enough for a pre-concert cruise. Tier B requires a 4-hour minimum (€4,719).
  • All bookings are handled via WhatsApp. We’ll confirm availability and send a payment link.

Other ways to enjoy Marbella by boat

If you’re in Marbella for more than a day, consider a full-day charter to Cabopino, Estepona, or Sotogrande. Our Marbella boat rental page has the full fleet and pricing. For a quick spin, the Speedboat (7 m, 6 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4 m, 5 pax) are fun, affordable options.

Frequently asked questions

How far is Puerto Banús from Starlite Festival?

Puerto Banús is about 6 km from the Nagüeles quarry where Starlite is held. A taxi takes 10–15 minutes and costs roughly €15–20. You can also arrange a private transfer through our team.

What time should I book my boat for a Starlite concert?

Most Starlite concerts start at 21:00 or 22:00. We recommend a 2-hour cruise departing at 17:00 or 18:00, returning to port by 19:00–20:00. This leaves time to freshen up and travel to the venue.

Can I watch the concert from the boat?

No. Starlite Festival is held in a landlocked quarry 2 km inland. You cannot see or hear the concert from the sea. The boat experience is a pre-concert cruise only.

What is included in the boat rental price?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA at 21%. No hidden extras.

Which boats are best for a Starlite pre-concert group?

For groups of 9–11, the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 (€749/2h) are ideal. For up to 12 guests with more space, the Mangusta 80 (€4,719/4h) includes a free jet ski. All depart from Puerto Banús.

Do you offer catering or dinner on board?

Standard charters include light snacks and drinks. For a full dinner or custom catering, we can arrange it on request. Contact us via WhatsApp for options and pricing.

How do I book a boat for Starlite Festival 2028?

You can book directly via WhatsApp. Specify your preferred date, boat type, and number of guests. Tier A and B boats have fixed prices online; other boats are quoted individually.

What is the cancellation policy?

Cancellations made 48 hours before departure receive a full refund. Within 48 hours, a 50% charge applies. No-shows are non-refundable. Weather-related cancellations are fully refunded.
